name: playmass
description: Interactive game platform for creating and distributing Hexa games to target groups with rewards management
author: Narimato

scripts.predev: node scripts/versioning/bump-version.mjs --type patch --reason "Automatic predev patch bump"
scripts.release:patch: node scripts/versioning/bump-version.mjs --type patch --reason "Patch release" && git add -A && git commit -m "release: v$(node scripts/versioning/get-version.mjs) — Patch release"
scripts.release:minor: node scripts/versioning/bump-version.mjs --type minor --reason "Minor release" && git add -A && git commit -m "release: v$(node scripts/versioning/get-version.mjs) — Minor release"
scripts.release:major: node scripts/versioning/bump-version.mjs --type major --reason "Major release" && git add -A && git commit -m "release: v$(node scripts/versioning/get-version.mjs) — Major release"
